column18: Survey of 79 low-power AI accelerators; neuromorphic only one of five criteria; main subject general accelerators
Spike-penalizing loss plus two-phase training to curb spike rate in deep SNNs; no figures given
SNN fault diagnosis vs second-generation NN on several datasets; low energy asserted, no efficiency metric reported
LTH-informed grouped kernel pruning with greedy kernel selection and fine-tuning; no efficiency figures
Strong LTH for binary networks: fixed binary weights, pruned subnetwork robust to attacks; no efficiency figures
Hyperspectral contraband CNN on GPU and neuromorphic modules; no spikes mentioned, no efficiency figures; neuromorphic accuracy lower
Learned binary masks with L0 and adversarial loss find robust tickets in pre-trained language models; no efficiency figures
SNN accelerator SATO vs 8-bit Eyeriss ANN accelerator: 30.9x speedup, 12.3x energy saving; vs SpinalFlow 6.4x, 4.8x
Input sparsity in fully connected SNN: MNIST size -58.16%, inference time -41.07%; Fashion-MNIST -55.99%, -59.05%
IMP-based sparse random feature models viewed as lottery tickets of two-layer networks; generalization analysis; no efficiency figures
ANN-SNN conversion with signed neuron; CIFAR10 95.44, CIFAR100 78.3, ImageNet 73.16 top-1; only latency vs other conversions
Signed supermask: weight selection and sign inversion, pruning rate up to 99% matching or exceeding baselines
Event-based CNN accelerator: 80-261 uJ/inference on DVS-Gesture at 1.2-4.9% input activity, 0.221 pJ/SOP; operations scale with events
SNN detection accelerator in 28nm exploiting activation and weight sparsity: 71.5% mAP, 35.88 TOPS/W, 1.05 mJ/frame
Pruning gives sparse double descent in test error; a winning ticket may not always win; no efficiency figures
Magnitude-pruned winning tickets beat dense nets with 50-100 examples per class; up to 16% absolute gain
LTH-based static and dynamic sparse adversarial training: 87.83% training and 87.82% inference FLOPs savings, CIFAR-100 ResNet-18
Bio-inspired spiking units in RNN-T: competitive ASR accuracy, significantly reduced computational cost and lower latency, no figures
SABP-trained SNN near best on MNIST and CIFAR-10, best on sonar; great energy and complexity advantage over ANN, unquantified
Benchmark of spike encoders with spiking CNN on FSD and WISDM; ANN transfer and compression unspecified; no efficiency figures
Neuromorphic 3D-NoC pneumonia X-ray: accuracy 88.43%; latency 4.6% better and power 32% lower than ANN-based system
ANN-SNN conversion, near-lossless on CIFAR and ImageNet; 32-512x fewer time steps than other conversion methods; no ANN efficiency comparison
CNN-to-SNN simulation for LiDAR 3D detection: equivalent run-time and accuracy on GPU; power gains only expected on neuromorphic hardware
Simulated-DVS emotion recognition: SNN better performance than ANN, energy one-quarter of ANN's
Spiking-GAN with TTFS: 57x lower energy than ANN GANs on MNIST; inference time improved over 33%, spikes cut over 11%
